name: havyn-train-v1
notes: Split by family, never by row: siblings of one archetype never straddle splits.

Held-out contains complete families - whole archetypes the model never saw in training. A task with fewer than three families cannot hold one out and keep one in train; the audit reports 0 heldout for it rather than hiding it.

Prompt gating: template prompts are rendered from the intent (fidelity by construction, prompt_gate=template_construction). Teacher prompts require an ACCEPT from an independent-model round-trip; the offline dry-run (reconstruction == source) is never accepted as that evidence.
